'''Lewis Blake''' (DeckTech handle '''Duke Devil''')<ref name="dt-23279">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23279 YEEeeah I've got the Hoth (Big) Blues Baby], DeckTech (Lewis "Duke Devil" Blake, 11 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23279/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23279/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009180809/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23279/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[You May Start Your Landing]] list on DeckTech (''YEEeeah I've got the Hoth (Big) Blues Baby'').
